title: Starting a Language Exchange
context: Lena 和 Marco 在第一次语言交换见面时商量练习方式，并决定下次带照片聊天。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和口语题均为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Is this seat free for the language exchange?
dialogue.zh: 语言交换活动这里的座位有人坐吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: It is. I am Marco. Are you here to practice Spanish?
dialogue.zh: 是的。我叫 Marco。你是来练习西班牙语的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm Lena. I can help you practice English, too.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我叫 Lena。我也可以帮你练习英语。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: That would be great. How should we divide our time?
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。我们怎么分配时间呢？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: How about fifteen minutes in each language?
dialogue.zh: 每种语言各练十五分钟怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: That sounds fair. Please speak slowly when we use Spanish.
dialogue.zh: 这样很公平。我们说西班牙语时请说慢一点。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Of course. And please tell me if I make a mistake.
dialogue.zh: 当然。如果我说错了，也请告诉我。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: I will. Would you rather talk about travel or hobbies today?
dialogue.zh: 好的。今天你更想聊旅行还是爱好？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Let's start with hobbies. I like drawing after work.
dialogue.zh: 先聊爱好吧。我喜欢下班后画画。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: I play soccer on weekends. We could bring photos next time.
dialogue.zh: 我周末踢足球。下次我们可以带照片来。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Good idea. Pictures will give us more to talk about.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。照片会让我们有更多话题。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: Then let's meet here again next Thursday after work.
dialogue.zh: 那我们下周四下班后再在这里见面吧。

expressions.zh: 分配时间，适合商量活动安排。
expressions.example: We can divide our time between reading and speaking.

expressions.zh: 说慢一点，方便对方听懂。
expressions.example: Could you speak slowly during the call?

expressions.zh: 犯错，指语言或其他活动中的错误。
expressions.example: It's fine to make a mistake while learning.
Let's start with a short question.

pronunciation: exchange 重音在第二音节；在 speak slowly 中，两个词开头的 /s/ 都要清楚，slowly 的重音在第一音节。

practice.title: Part 1 · Learning languages
practice.prompt: How do you practice a new language?
practice.answer: I practice with a friend once a week. We ask each other simple questions, and I write down useful new words.

practice.title: Part 2 · A conversation partner
practice.prompt: Describe someone you would like to practice a language with. Say who the person is, what you would talk about, and why.
practice.answer: I would like to practice Spanish with my friend Ana. She is patient and enjoys talking about daily life. We could meet at a cafe after work and spend half an hour speaking together. I would ask her about her favorite places and tell her about my hobbies. If I made a mistake, I would ask her to help me correct it. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Learning together
practice.prompt: How can conversation partners help language learners?
practice.answer: They give learners a chance to use words in real conversations. Partners can also explain mistakes gently and help each other stay motivated.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读双方商量练习时间的句子，再邀请一位语伴并提出话题。
practice.answer: Would you like to practice together? We can spend fifteen minutes in each language. Let's talk about our hobbies first.
